name: Tiger 4
subtitle: High post entry, backdoor cuts
goal: Get the ball to the high post, then cut behind defenders who are watching it.
options: 41: 2 backdoor. 42: 3 backdoor off 5's screen. Nothing? 4 drives or shoots.

steps.note: 1 passes to 4 at the high post. 4 reverse pivots to face up the defender in triple threat: drive, shoot, or pass.
41: 2 cuts backdoor. 4 looks for the pass.
42: 5 goes to screen for 3. 2 clears out to the corner.
3 cuts backdoor off 5's screen. 4 hits the open cutter, or drives or shoots.
